name: Iskra
description: Iskra in Zeron: an animated companion mirroring chat status, agent usage as Zeron last read it, and opt-in controls for the separate zeron-pet desktop helper.
settings_description: Iskra's home in Zeron: a companion in the header, her own page, your agents' usage, and opt-in desktop pet controls.

settings.label: Iskra in the header
settings.description: A small animated Iskra and the chat's status by a chat's header.

settings.label: Animate
settings.description: Play Iskra's animations. Off holds a still frame; Zeron's reduced-motion setting also holds it still.

settings.label: Agent usage
settings.description: Show each active provider's usage windows on Iskra's page, as Zeron last read them.

settings.label: Desktop pet controls
settings.description: Buttons that run the separate zeron-pet helper (Linux/Wayland). Nothing runs until you click.

settings.label: Codex
settings.description: Codex's usage row on Iskra's page.

options.label: Auto
options.description: Shown when Zeron reports usage for it.

options.label: Show
options.description: Always listed; marked unavailable when Zeron reports nothing.

options.label: Hide
options.description: Never listed, even when Zeron reports usage.
